specs.title: keyboard zoom and reset do not zoom the page @ref prd:zoom.no_page_zoom
ctrl+wheel zooms the board @ref prd:zoom.pointer
hint disappears after first pan and stays gone @ref prd:nav.hint
drag pans content exactly with the pointer @ref prd:pan.drag
wheel scroll pans in scroll direction @ref prd:pan.scroll
zoom keeps the point under the pointer fixed @ref prd:zoom.pointer
reset view returns to 100% with origin centred @ref prd:view.reset
golden path: create, type, select, recolour, delete @ref prd:golden-path
double-click creates note centred on the point @ref prd:sticky.create_dblclick
toolbar button creates note in view centre @ref prd:sticky.create_button
escape and outside click keep typed text; Enter re-edits at end @ref prd:sticky.edit_end
pasting over the limit keeps exactly 1000 characters @ref prd:sticky.text_limit
dragging a note moves it, not the board @ref prd:sticky.move prd:sticky.no_pan
dragged note is drawn above the note it overlaps @ref prd:sticky.move
Delete while editing edits text, not the note @ref prd:sticky.delete
delete button on note toolbar removes note @ref prd:sticky.delete
clicking empty board clears selection @ref prd:sticky.select
create, type, move, recolour and delete reach the other person @ref prd:live.propagate
late joiner sees current notes @ref prd:live.join_state
simultaneous typing keeps both people's characters @ref prd:live.concurrent_text
